methodName.description: The name of the overridden method.

overriddenParams.description:
Boolean to indicate whether the number of parameters or parameter types changed
in the overridden function.

modifiedReturnType.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link ValueType} of the method's return type. Set to null if no
modification is made to the method's return type.

modifiedReturnValueModifier.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link ValueModifier} of the method's return type. Set to null if no
modification is made to the method's return type modifier.

modifiedRuntime.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link Action.Requirement} of the method. Set to null if no
modification is made to the method's action requirement.

title: Type to structure the override information for methods.
name: BaseCustomizationAnalysis.Type.Overrides.Method
